cooling_off.quote: No. You cannot reapply for a position if you have been declined for it.
cooling_off.notes: Parsed scope this_role: the FAQ rule is per job opening ("You cannot reapply for a position if you have been declined for it"; "You must apply separately to each job opening"). FAQ additionally states: "When you withdraw your submitted application from a job opening, the tool prevents you from reapplying to the job." No numeric cooling-off duration or global application cap was found on this page — the rule as stated is a permanent per-req bar, not a time-limited cooling-off period. Second stated FAQ rule, browser-verified 2026-07-29, verbatim: 'You cannot re-apply to the same job opening. You can apply to different job requisitions even with the same job code and title. However, an assessment outcome is generally valid for six months. Any job requisition that has the same assessment will use the existing outcome for that period of time.' The six-month assessment validity is hedged ('generally') and so stays out of the parsed fields.
